promised_capability: Capsule Networks (Hinton) Replacing CNNs & Transformers
technical_mechanism: Dynamic routing between capsules learning part-whole hierarchies with 10x less data
outcome_explanation: Out-Standardized / Hardware Scaling (Transformers scaled cleanly on GPUs at G0-L6; Capsules hit compute wall)
evolutionary_lesson: Hardware lottery & GPU matrix-multiply parallelism beat bespoke routing architectures.

promised_capability: Symbolic-Neural Hybrid Ontologies (OWL/RDF + DL) as Only Path to Reasoning
technical_mechanism: Hand-crafted knowledge graphs governing neural feature extractors
outcome_explanation: Foundation Model Absorption (In-context learning & RLVR absorbed soft reasoning without manual ontologies)
evolutionary_lesson: Bitter Lesson: compute-scaled pretraining + RLVR outperforms hand-coded symbolic ontologies.

promised_capability: Universal Small-Data Transfer Learning Eliminating Large Pretraining Clusters
technical_mechanism: Single-GPU fine-tuning of 30M-100M models beating giant models on all tasks
outcome_explanation: Foundation Model Absorption (G0-L6 GPT-3 175B scaling laws proved giant zero/few-shot models dominate)
evolutionary_lesson: Small task-specific encoders remain useful at L4, but general reasoning requires frontier L6 scale.

promised_capability: Pretrained Transformer Representation Transfer Across Text, Code & Vision
technical_mechanism: Unified self-attention backbone scaling to generative text and code
outcome_explanation: Matured from G0-L6 (TRL 1-3) to TRL 9 (Became foundation of Gen 1-4)
evolutionary_lesson: General architecture scaling with compute becomes the universal substrate across modalities.

promised_capability: Standalone Prompt Marketplaces (PromptBase) & $335k 'Prompt Whisperer' Careers
technical_mechanism: Buying and selling secret $4.99 prompt strings and cargo-cult incantations as durable IP
outcome_explanation: Foundation Model Absorption (G1-L6 RLHF instruction tuning & G3-L6 RLVR thinking made secret prompt hacks obsolete)
evolutionary_lesson: Surface-level prompt syntax has an 18-month half-life before RLHF/RLVR absorbs it into L1.

promised_capability: Zero-Code End-to-End Production SaaS Generation from Single Codex Docstring in 2021
technical_mechanism: Non-programmers generating full production backends from 1 paragraph in 2021
outcome_explanation: Premature TRL / Capability Starvation (4k context & 0% multi-file state awareness caused immediate build failure until Gen 3/4)
evolutionary_lesson: Multi-file app generation required 128k+ context, RLVR coding, and browser sandboxes (v0/Bolt) 3 years later.

promised_capability: Conversational Instruction-Following & RLHF Alignment for Mass Consumers
technical_mechanism: Turning raw completion models into safe zero-shot dialogue assistants
outcome_explanation: Matured from G1-L6 (TRL 1-3) to TRL 9 (Triggered Gen 2 ChatGPT explosion)
evolutionary_lesson: Post-training alignment unlocks 10x consumer adoption by removing few-shot formatting friction.

promised_capability: Unconstrained Recursive Autonomous Loops (AutoGPT / BabyAGI) Running Businesses in 2023
technical_mechanism: Infinite while-loops over GPT-4 autonomously executing multi-day company projects
outcome_explanation: Premature TRL / Capability Starvation (0.90^20 = 12.2% step survival caused infinite loops & $50 API burn)
evolutionary_lesson: Compound error decay requires cyclic state checkpoints (G3-L4 LangGraph) and RLVR (G4) before long horizons work.

promised_capability: Every Enterprise Training Its Own From-Scratch Base LLM (BloombergGPT Model)
technical_mechanism: Banks, hospitals, and retailers pretraining proprietary 50B base models from scratch
outcome_explanation: Broken Unit Economics & Maintenance Friction (Frontier L6 APIs + L3/L4 RAG/QLoRA beat $3M bespoke base models in 6 months)
evolutionary_lesson: Domain adaptation belongs at L3-L5 (Context Engineering, QLoRA, domain RLVR), not $3M L6 pretraining.

promised_capability: Pure Vector Databases Permanently Replacing Long Context Windows
technical_mechanism: 4k-8k context remaining permanent; every 10-page document requiring vector chunking
outcome_explanation: Foundation Model Absorption (G2-L6 RoPE 128k-2M long context + 90% prompt caching absorbed <50-PDF Q&A into G3-L2)
evolutionary_lesson: Vector search survived for million-doc enterprise corpora, but <50-PDF RAG sank into L2 long-context folders.

promised_capability: Proprietary Per-Vendor Chat Plugin Stores (Early ChatGPT Plugins 2023)
technical_mechanism: Closed vendor-specific JSON plugin manifests becoming the new App Store
outcome_explanation: Out-Standardized (Deprecated in favor of open function calling and G3-L6 Anthropic/AAIF Model Context Protocol [MCP])
evolutionary_lesson: Open cross-vendor protocols (MCP / A2A) beat walled-garden tool manifests.

promised_capability: Native Multimodal Omni-Models & 100k-2M Long-Context Workspaces
technical_mechanism: Unified text-vision-audio models with massive context and live code rendering
outcome_explanation: Matured from G2-L6 (TRL 1-3) to TRL 9 (Triggered Gen 3 Omni-Chat, Projects & Artifacts)
evolutionary_lesson: Early-fusion multimodal tokenization and FlashAttention-2 collapsed modality silos into L1/L2.

promised_capability: Thin Single-Prompt SaaS Wrappers ('Chat with One PDF' Startups) as Defensible Moats
technical_mechanism: Charging $20/mo for a single system prompt + file upload button over OpenAI API
outcome_explanation: Foundation Model Absorption (Crushed when Claude Projects, NotebookLM & ChatGPT Canvas built it into L1/L2 for free)
evolutionary_lesson: Never build a startup on a thin UI feature that sits 1 generation away from L1 foundation model absorption.

promised_capability: 100% Unsupervised Zero-Human-Review Full-Lifecycle Software Engineering by 2025
proponents: SAE L5 Coding Hype / Early Devin Claims
technical_mechanism: Firing engineering teams and letting autonomous agents push directly to production without review
outcome_explanation: Premature TRL (Scale SWE-bench Pro proved 70%+ public vs 23-46% private repo accuracy; unreviewed vibe coding creates Code Slop)
evolutionary_lesson: Verification Asymmetry: as generation gets cheaper, L4 decoupled verification oracles become the primary bottleneck.

promised_capability: In-House Custom Horizontal Enterprise AI Builds Beating Purchased Vertical Tools
technical_mechanism: Internal IT building bespoke horizontal agent platforms beating commercial domain vendors
outcome_explanation: Broken Unit Economics (MIT NANDA 2025 proved 67% success for bought tools vs 33% for in-house builds; Menlo 76% bought)
evolutionary_lesson: Enterprises succeed by buying vertical tools and focusing L3/L4 engineering on proprietary context & oracles.

promised_capability: Test-Time Reasoning (RLVR) + Standardized Tool Protocols (MCP) + Terminal CLI Agents
technical_mechanism: RL on verifiable rewards unlocking multi-step terminal coding and standardized tool wiring
outcome_explanation: Matured from G3-L6 (TRL 1-3) to TRL 9 (Triggered Gen 4 Auto-Thinking, Deep Research, MCP & Claude Code)
evolutionary_lesson: Verifiable reward training (RLVR) + open tool protocols (MCP) unlocked multi-hour METR autonomy horizons.

promised_capability: Unauthenticated Zero-Sandbox Local MCP & Browser Agents Running with Root Credentials
technical_mechanism: Giving autonomous agents unrestricted host shell and primary browser cookie access
outcome_explanation: Broken Security (CVE-2025-53773, ClawHavoc & Apr 2026 OX Security 200k MCP RCEs forced air-gapped M4 Mac Mini sandboxes at G4-L5)
evolutionary_lesson: High-autonomy agents with shell/tool execution require physical or microVM containment boundaries (L5).

promised_capability: Pure Pixel-Only GUI Clicking Replacing All API & CLI Harnesses in 2026
technical_mechanism: Agents operating exclusively by taking screenshots and clicking pixels at 3-5s/click
outcome_explanation: Broken Unit Economics (Bash CLI + MCP API calls are 50x faster and 20x cheaper; GUI clicking reserved for legacy non-API apps)
evolutionary_lesson: Code/CLI/MCP is the native high-bandwidth action space for agents; pixel GUI clicking is a fallback.

promised_capability: OpenAI Level 4 'Innovators' & Level 5 'Autonomous Organizations' Operating at L1 in 2026
technical_mechanism: AI autonomously discovering new physical laws and running entire corporations without humans in 2026
outcome_explanation: Premature TRL (2026 frontier deployments require L4 decoupled verification oracles and L6 human theoretical formulation)
evolutionary_lesson: Top rungs of 1D company ladders project next-gen L5-L6 research aspirations onto current consumer tools.

promised_capability: Sandboxed Multi-Agent Verification Swarms & Continuous RLVR Domain Flywheels
technical_mechanism: Isolated hardware/container sandboxes running parallel verified agent worktrees & RLVR loops
outcome_explanation: Active Frontier at Gen 4 Level 5-6 (Expanding into Gen 5 Lean 4 swarms and nightly enclave RLVR)
evolutionary_lesson: Pairing parallel sandboxed execution with formal verification oracles is the true bridge to Gen 5.
